On this page, we have embedded web applications which can support you to complete checklists, frameworks and guidance associated with STARS. Navigate between the tabs to your desired checklist:

## STARS Reuse

::: {.column-screen-inset}
```{shinylive-python}
#| standalone: true
#| viewerHeight: 1000

from __future__ import annotations

from shiny import App, Inputs, Outputs, Session, reactive, render, ui

# ---- Helper: field definitions ----

# Core STARS Reuse items (essential + optional, grouped)
SECTIONS = [
    {
        "id": "essential",
        "title": "Essential components",
        "items": [
            {
                "id": "open_licence",
                "label": "Open licence",
                "help": (
                    "Specify that the model artefacts are released under an "
                    "explicit open licence (e.g. MIT, GPL), and where this is stated."
                ),
            },
            {
                "id": "foss_licence",
                "label": "FOSS licence",
                "help": (
                    "Provide the specific free and open-source licence "
                    "for the code and other artefacts (e.g. MIT, GPL-3.0)."
                ),
            },
            {
                "id": "dependency_mgmt",
                "label": "Dependency management",
                "help": (
                    "Describe how dependencies are specified and managed "
                    "(e.g. requirements.txt, conda environment.yml, poetry)."
                ),
            },
            {
                "id": "foss_language",
                "label": "FOSS model language",
                "help": (
                    "State the language(s) used (e.g. Python, R, Julia) "
                    "and confirm they are FOSS."
                ),
            },
            {
                "id": "min_docs",
                "label": "Minimum documentation",
                "help": (
                    "Summarise where minimal documentation is found: "
                    "what the model does, how to install/run, how to vary parameters."
                ),
            },
            {
                "id": "orcids",
                "label": "ORCID for authors",
                "help": "List ORCID identifiers for each study author, or explain where they are provided.",
            },
            {
                "id": "citation_info",
                "label": "Citation information",
                "help": (
                    "Explain how to cite the artefact (e.g. CITATION.cff, "
                    "Zenodo record, README section)."
                ),
            },
            {
                "id": "remote_repo",
                "label": "Remote code repository",
                "help": "Provide the public repository URL(s) (e.g. GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket).",
            },
            {
                "id": "open_science_archive",
                "label": "Open science archive",
                "help": (
                    "Provide DOI / URL(s) for persistent archives "
                    "(e.g. Zenodo, OSF, Figshare, CoMSES Net)."
                ),
            },
        ],
    },
    {
        "id": "optional",
        "title": "Optional components",
        "items": [
            {
                "id": "enhanced_docs",
                "label": "Enhanced documentation",
                "help": (
                    "Describe any richer documentation (Quarto/Jupyter books, "
                    "TRACE, reporting guidelines, validation description, etc.)."
                ),
            },
            {
                "id": "docs_hosting",
                "label": "Documentation hosting",
                "help": "Give URLs and hosting platform(s) for the documentation (e.g. GitHub Pages, Quarto Pub).",
            },
            {
                "id": "online_env",
                "label": "Online coding environment",
                "help": "List any Binder, Colab, Deepnote etc. environments and what they support.",
            },
            {
                "id": "model_interface",
                "label": "Model interface",
                "help": (
                    "Describe any web or GUI interfaces for non-technical users "
                    "(e.g. Shiny, Streamlit, Dash)."
                ),
            },
            {
                "id": "web_app_hosting",
                "label": "Web app hosting",
                "help": "Provide URLs and hosting details for any deployed web apps.",
            },
        ],
    },
]

APP_TITLE = "STARS Reuse Framework (Shiny for Python)"


# ---- UI ----

def make_section(section: dict) -> ui.Tag:
    """Render a card with textareas for all items in a section."""
    items_ui = []
    for item in section["items"]:
        items_ui.append(
            ui.div(
                ui.h4(item["label"]),
                ui.p(item["help"], class_="text-muted"),
                ui.input_text_area(
                    item["id"],
                    label=None,
                    placeholder="Enter details here…",
                    rows=4,
                    width="100%",
                ),
                class_="mb-4",
            )
        )
    return ui.card(
        ui.card_header(section["title"]),
        *items_ui,
        class_="mb-4",
    )


app_ui = ui.page_fluid(
    ui.h2(APP_TITLE),
    ui.p(
        "Use this form to record how a simulation study satisfies the STARS Reuse "
        "framework items. When finished, use the Download button to obtain a "
        "markdown summary that can be stored with the model artefacts."
    ),
    ui.layout_columns(
        ui.card(
            ui.card_header("Project metadata"),
            ui.input_text("project_title", "Project title", ""),
            ui.input_text("project_id", "Project ID / short name", ""),
            ui.input_text("contact_name", "Contact person", ""),
            ui.input_text("contact_email", "Contact email", ""),
        ),
        ui.card(
            ui.card_header("Export"),
            ui.input_select(
                "export_format",
                "Export format",
                choices=["markdown"],  # extensible later to docx/pdf
                selected="markdown",
            ),
            ui.input_text(
                "filename",
                "File name (without extension)",
                "stars_reuse_checklist",
            ),
            ui.input_switch(
                "include_empty",
                "Include empty items in export",
                value=True,
            ),
            ui.input_action_button("download_btn", "Download completed checklist"),
            ui.output_text_verbatim("download_hint"),
        ),
        col_widths=(7, 5),
    ),
    ui.hr(),
    make_section(SECTIONS[0]),
    make_section(SECTIONS[1]),
    class_="p-3",
)


# ---- Server logic ----

def server(input: Inputs, output: Outputs, session: Session) -> None:
    @reactive.calc
    def collected_items():
        """Return a list of dicts with all item values."""
        data = []
        for section in SECTIONS:
            for item in section["items"]:
                value = getattr(input, item["id"])()
                data.append(
                    {
                        "section_id": section["id"],
                        "section_title": section["title"],
                        "id": item["id"],
                        "label": item["label"],
                        "value": value.strip() if value else "",
                    }
                )
        return data

    @reactive.calc
    def markdown_export() -> str:
        """Build a markdown document containing project metadata and checklist."""
        title = input.project_title().strip() or "Untitled project"
        proj_id = input.project_id().strip()
        contact_name = input.contact_name().strip()
        contact_email = input.contact_email().strip()
        include_empty = input.include_empty()

        lines: list[str] = []

        # Header
        lines.append(f"# STARS Reuse Framework")
        lines.append("")
        lines.append(f"**Project title:** {title}")
        if proj_id:
            lines.append(f"**Project ID:** {proj_id}")
        if contact_name or contact_email:
            contact_bits = ", ".join(
                [b for b in [contact_name or None, contact_email or None] if b]
            )
            lines.append(f"**Contact:** {contact_bits}")
        lines.append("")

        # Checklist sections
        items = collected_items()
        for section in SECTIONS:
            lines.append(f"## {section['title']}")
            lines.append("")
            for item in [i for i in items if i["section_id"] == section["id"]]:
                if not include_empty and not item["value"]:
                    continue
                lines.append(f"### {item['label']}")
                lines.append("")
                if item["value"]:
                    lines.append(item["value"])
                else:
                    lines.append("_No information provided yet._")
                lines.append("")

        return "\n".join(lines)

    @output
    @render.text
    def download_hint():
        fmt = input.export_format()
        return (
            "Click the Download button to save a markdown file containing the "
            f"current responses in the checklist. You can then store it alongside "
            "your model artefacts or convert it to other formats (e.g. docx/pdf) "
            "using Quarto or pandoc."
        )

    @render.download(
        filename=lambda: f"stars_reuse_{date.today().isoformat()}.md"
    )
    def download_checklist():
        content = "# Example\n\nThis is a test file.\n"
        # Can yield once or multiple times
        yield content
    #@render.download(filename=lambda: f"{input.filename() or #'stars_reuse_checklist'}.md")
    #def download_btn():
    #    # Only markdown supported here; other formats would be handled client-side
    #    # or via separate tooling.
    #    content = markdown_export()
    #    yield content.encode("utf-8")


app = App(app_ui, server)
```
